properties.ntfct_text_eng:
Gulf of Finland

Firing exercises are taking place west of Naissaar island in firing practice area 2A centred 59°35’N, 024°19’E from 6 October at 10:00 to 8 October at 17:00 (local time). Other vessels must avoid entry into the area.
Operative information on VHF channels 13 and 61.

Estonian chart 610 (INT 1123), 507 (INT 1267)
